ver: Artifact-level version counter. Not used by dep-graph — field versions are tracked separately in project.json. May be incremented manually if needed.
meta.title: Application name, copied from PRD meta.title.
meta.updated_at: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last write.
system_type: High-level description of the system — e.g. 'Web app (SPA + REST API)', 'Mobile app (iOS + Android)', 'API-only service', 'Desktop app'.
architecture_pattern.name: Name of the architectural pattern chosen — e.g. 'CLEAN Architecture', 'MVC', 'Hexagonal / Ports & Adapters', 'Event-Driven'.
architecture_pattern.description: 1–2 sentences explaining why this pattern was chosen for this specific project.
architecture_pattern.components: Architectural layers or components as applied in this project. Each entry: { name: layer/component name, role: what this layer is responsible for in this project }. Component names and count vary by pattern and project — define only layers that are actually used.
tech_stack: Technology choices per layer. Layers are free-form and defined during the interview — use only layers relevant to this system. Each entry: { layer: e.g. 'frontend' | 'backend' | 'database' | 'mobile' | 'infrastructure' | 'cache' | 'queue', choice: the technology or framework chosen }.
deployment.model: How the system is deployed — e.g. 'Cloud (managed)', 'Cloud (self-managed)', 'On-premise', 'Hybrid'.
integrations: External systems or services this app integrates with. Each entry: { name: service name, purpose: why it is needed, type: 'external-api' | 'third-party-sdk' | 'internal-service' }. Empty array if none.
nfr: Non-functional requirements — architectural quality attributes derived from PRD constraints, goals, and scale expectation. Each entry: { category: 'performance' | 'security' | 'scalability' | 'availability' | 'compliance', requirement: the specific requirement }.
architecture_notes: Free-form notes on key architectural decisions, trade-offs, or constraints not captured in other fields. Optional — leave empty string if nothing to add.
